import json

# Categories inferred from the 75 given sentences.
# Observed constraints: opinion < size < age < shape < material < color < purpose < origin < head noun.
# Shape-vs-material is not directly constrained by the givens; shape is placed first, as in the given
# "brand-new triangular fire extinguisher" pattern. Flagged in evidence.
ORDER = ["opinion", "size", "age", "shape", "material", "color", "purpose", "origin"]
RANK = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(ORDER)}

CAT = {
    # opinion
    "good": "opinion", "terrible": "opinion", "awful": "opinion",
    "lovely": "opinion", "repulsive": "opinion", "wonderful": "opinion",
    # size
    "large": "size", "little": "size", "tiny": "size", "midsize": "size",
    "medium-size": "size", "normal-size": "size", "huge": "size", "small": "size",
    # age
    "old": "age", "old-fashioned": "age", "brand-new": "age", "ancient": "age",
    "archaic": "age", "new": "age",
    # shape
    "circular": "shape", "triangular": "shape", "pyramidal": "shape",
    "rectangular": "shape", "square": "shape", "spherical": "shape",
    # material
    "glass": "material", "iron": "material", "cardboard": "material",
    "cloth": "material", "leather": "material", "plastic": "material",
    "steel": "material", "paper": "material",
    # color
    "pink": "color", "black": "color", "red": "color", "yellow": "color",
    "green": "color", "violet": "color", "white": "color", "blue": "color",
    # purpose / gerund modifiers
    "hiking": "purpose", "eating": "purpose", "snorkeling": "purpose",
    "walking": "purpose", "smoking": "purpose", "drinking": "purpose",
    "whittling": "purpose", "driving": "purpose", "typing": "purpose",
    "exercise": "purpose",
    # origin
    "german": "origin", "mexican": "origin", "turkish": "origin",
    "nigerian": "origin", "american": "origin", "bangladeshi": "origin",
    "chinese": "origin", "egyptian": "origin", "indian": "origin",
    "indonesian": "origin", "ethiopian": "origin",
}

OPTIONS = {
    "A": "good large leather red hiking german brand-new key",
    "B": "circular glass pink hiking mexican little repulsive saw",
    "C": "triangular old-fashioned iron pink eating turkish midsize canvas",
    "D": "old cardboard black snorkeling nigerian large terrible fork",
    "E": "terrible midsize cloth green walking american old pyramidal box",
    "F": "awful tiny glass yellow smoking bangladeshi wrench",
    "G": "lovely little plastic red drinking american pyramidal bowl",
    "H": "old pyramidal leather violet whittling turkish chair",
    "I": "ancient rectangular steel violet eating mexican normal-size wonderful watch",
    "J": "medium-size plastic white walking bangladeshi old rectangular hat",
}

def check(sentence):
    words = sentence.split()
    head, modifiers = words[-1], words[:-1]  # last word is the head noun
    ranks, unknown = [], []
    for w in modifiers:
        c = CAT.get(w)
        if c is None:
            unknown.append(w)
        else:
            ranks.append((w, c, RANK[c]))
    if unknown:
        return None, ranks, unknown
    ok = all(ranks[i][2] <= ranks[i + 1][2] for i in range(len(ranks) - 1))
    return ok, ranks, unknown

results = {}
correct = []
unsupported = []
for label, sent in OPTIONS.items():
    ok, ranks, unknown = check(sent)
    results[label] = {
        "sentence": sent,
        "ordered_categories": [c for _, c, _ in ranks],
        "unknown_words": unknown,
        "valid": ok,
    }
    if ok is None:
        unsupported.append(label)
    elif ok:
        correct.append(label)

if unsupported:
    final = "UNSUPPORTED"
elif not correct:
    final = "K"
else:
    final = "".join(correct)

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": final,
    "evidence": {
        "inferred_order": ORDER + ["head_noun"],
        "option_checks": results,
        "assumption": "shape placed before material; not constrained by the givens",
    },
}, indent=2))
